documents.content: PROCUREMENT APPROVAL MATRIX V2 (effective 2026-01-01), extends the standard matrix with a Junior Buyer tier for routine low-value purchases: Junior Buyer up to $5,000; Manager up to $10,000; Director up to $50,000; VP unlimited within board-approved budget.
Subject: Silverlake infrastructure contract. Approving $500,000 for the Silverlake Municipal Contractors (VENDOR-6011) infrastructure contract -- proceeding within my authority as Junior Buyer.

Subject: Meadowcross annual contract, NORTH region. Approving the $200,000 annual contract with Meadowcross Analytics (VENDOR-6012) for the NORTH region operations team -- within my unlimited VP authority per the current approval matrix and board-approved FY26 budget. -- L. Bergstrom, VP Operations.

PURCHASE ORDER PO-6012S. Vendor: Meadowcross Analytics (VENDOR-6012). Amount authorized: $200,000.00. Business unit: SOUTH region operations. Description: annual contract -- unrelated transaction to the NORTH region VP approval despite the matching vendor and dollar amount.
